name: brink-dashboard
description: Internal Brink Design app: one site for each brink-merge project (Projects, then Takeoff | Schematic | BOM & Issues per project). Phase 1 is read-only and live: a React SPA served by a Cloudflare Worker that reads Postgres through Hyperdrive, with a Durable Object relaying Supabase Realtime.
